notes.title: Early Access 6.0 "Naymor Arrives"
notes.content:
Note: If you're still running an older version of the game (see your game version at the top left) verify your game files by right-clicking the game, clicking properties > local files > and pressing "Verify integrity of game files". This should force Steam to download the latest updates.

Additions

New Alien: Mutant
New Advanced Operator: Michael
Valve Anti-Cheat has been added to all servers
New Market Menu: New & Featured, which the Market now defaults to displaying
New Market Menu: Aliens


Balancing

Arachnid's stun attack reduced stun time from 4 seconds to 3
Arachnid's slash attack damage increased from 71~85 to 75~85


Changes

Almost every sound in-game has been modified
Lobby chat character limit has been increased from 40 to 50
Several UI changes have been made throughout the main menu and its various other connecting menus
The end round screen now displays the operator used by the player rather than "TestPerson"
Reduced the number of frames that a laser gun's laser displays


Fixes

Fixed glitch where someone could choose to play the alien on the objectives game mode (which would cause them to crash)
Fixed glitch where rechargeable abilities & gadgets would have their timer reset when hitting 0 even if the ability/gadget hadn't been used
Fixed glitch where hunters that killed the alien, and sometimes those who were still alive would have their damage dealt & taken displayed as 0
Fixed desync issue where laser weapons would deal a different amount of damage for each client


Community
The game now has an official community discord server which I highly recommend you check out here: https://discord.gg/ArEbAut

Notes
Reading one of the reviews I noticed there was a bit of confusion around my version setup and that having it read big numbers up front made it seem like the game was further along than it was, so allow me to clarify my process:

A game version is X.Y where x is the content update and Y is any bug/hotfixes or minor additions to that update. It's not a decimal system but rather the period is used as a separator so if I hit a 10th bug/hotfix it would be X.10 even though from a math standpoint x.1 is equal to x.10, but again it's meant to be a separator, not an actual decimal.

So say I add a new map or operator, that would be a content update so I'd take the current version (for example 12) and add 1 so the next update would be 13.0, but then someone discovered that you could crash the game by doing something on that map and I fixed it, that update would be 13.1 because it's not adding anything important to the game in terms of content, but rather modifying/fixing the already existing content.

Hope that helps!

notes.title: Early Access 5.0
notes.content:
Note: If you're still running an older version of the game (see your game version at the top left) verify your game files by right-clicking the game, clicking properties > local files > and pressing "Verify integrity of game files". This should force Steam to download the latest updates.

Additions

New Game Mode: Operations
New Operations Map: Sanctuary
New Door Type: Unlockable
New Enemy AI: Mini Arachnid
New Enemy AI: Large Arachnid
New Enemy AI: Slug


Balancing

Increased Discharge Cannon range from 7m to 10m


Changes

The ship when loading into The Valiant now says "The Valiant" instead of "U.S.S AES"
Servers now display what they're hosting (The map & game mode)
Bullets no longer effect physics like props and curtains as a test to see if it reduces crashing
The main menu bin is no longer clipping in the floor ramp
Increased the height of the spectate camera
Servers now include basic information at the top above the chat
Increased lobby refresh rate from 0.5s to 0.2s
Create room screen now features the map "U.S.S AES" displayed as "USS AES" since that is the map's network name and what will be shown on the servers list
Made player camers more centered on the player
Increased occlussion culling to static level props, reducing GPU usage (Plainly: Reduced graphics card stress)
Added lightmap to Sanctuary map as an experiment to reduce GPU usage, if successful may add to other maps
Reduced flash intensity for the sake of not blinding players on the new map, with the added bonus of the standard game mode feeling more eerie with less bright flashing
Changed bullet tracer & flash color to red
Guns no longer consider aliens and players as solid objects and therefore the restriction of being unable to shoot while too close no longer applies to them
Changed the order in which game modes display, prioritizing the functional ones over the currently non-existant ones


Fixes

Fixed glitch where when the host left the room the player still saw themselves as being inside of it even after being kicked out
Fixed glitch where loading certain network resources at runtime could cause the game to crash


Community
The game now has an official community discord server which I highly recommend you check out here: https://discord.gg/ArEbAut

I've met a lot of awesome people and hang out there all the time, as well as give in-advance discussions on upcoming updates.

Notes
The operations game mode has brought a lot more Host-focused content which means it's even more important than before that the host be someone with a decent PC and internet for the sake of keeping smooth gameplay. Due to this there are also several possible glitches that could occur should the host leave mid-match, so please be wary of this. Thanks.

The "Sanctuary" map for the new Operations game mode will not be added to the creation-queue just yet as it is still in testing. To create a server hosting this map you must create a custom room, random matchmaking can still place you in rooms with these new game modes but will not automatically host one.

notes.title: Early Access 4.0
notes.content:
Note: If you're still running an older version of the game (see your game version at the top left) verify your game files by right-clicking the game, clicking properties > local files > and pressing "Verify integrity of game files". This should force Steam to download the latest updates.

Additions

New Map: The Valiant


Balancing
This update hopes to make the game less grindy

All standard operators reduced the price from 5,000 to 3,000
All advanced operators reduced the price from 12,000 to 8,000


A Note
I thought it was really important to get this map out right away so that the game had more content, but expect relatively soon that servers list will start displaying maps and that this second map and the first map will be given more detail.

Since this update introduces an entirely new map with new possibilities there might be a few bugs so please report them if you find them!

There appears to still be a lot of crashing going on, so again, please comment when you crash, what you were doing, what was going on, etc. I really want to fix these as soon as I can!

notes.title: Early Access 3.2
notes.content:
Note: If you're still running an older version of the game (see your game version at the top left) verify your game files by right-clicking the game, clicking properties > local files > and pressing "Verify integrity of game files". This should force Steam to download the latest updates.

Changes

Made ending screen a solid color screen rather than a realtime one
Spectator camera is now zoomed out further, originally it was zoomed in to prevent network lagg spectator advantages
Blood splatters now have a slightly randomized height as to avoid overlapping


Fixes

Fixed network sync issues caused by control panels and vents that could cause error buildups leading to crashes
Fixed network sync issues caused by cloth colliders that could cause error buildups leading to crashes
Fixed glitch where holding down right click while spectating could cause the camera to rotate out of position
Fixed glitch where blood particle systems would not destroy and constantly build up, resulting in an increase in CPU Usage the longer you play the game
Fixed bug where ammo counter would not display "RELOADING" however now it always displays for the alien


Notes
I'm preparing for multi-map support right now, it's going to take some reprogramming and other things, but so long as this update helps reduce crashes and no new bugs arise I should be able to start on the operations game mode within a few hours after this update goes live.

This build was just about trying to further fix crashes, which really are my main goal. Hopefully this will help elimenate them and I can get on to adding other features! And hopefully this doesn't break the game like the initial 3.0 did..

notes.title: Early Access 3.1
notes.content:
Note: If you're still running an older version of the game (see your game version at the top left) verify your game files by right-clicking the game, clicking properties > local files > and pressing "Verify integrity of game files". This should force Steam to download the latest updates.

A Major Bug Fix
In testing this bug didn't occur but once I joined someone else's lobby I found myself waiting on the ship screen and never spawning. This is because the same code that fixed crashes also broke loading into the map because I'm not allowed to be happy.

As soon as I discovered this I put the game version back to 2.0, but everything should be fixed now. Let me know.

notes.title: Early Access 3.0
notes.content:
Note: If you're still running an older version of the game (see your game version at the top left) verify your game files by right-clicking the game, clicking properties > local files > and pressing "Verify integrity of game files". This should force Steam to download the latest updates.

Additions

In-game icons now indicating what weapons you have, what your gadgets are, how many you have left, and what their cooldowns are
Player's health will now show up when going near each other
Added new icons:

Aliens: Arachnid
Weapons: Discharge Cannon, Accelerated Magnum, CPB Rifle, Auto Shotgun, Mini-3, Mini-Mini-3
Abilities: Flesh Shell, Slash, Stun



Balancing

Increased Arachnid primary attack damage from 71~80 to 71~85
Increased Arachnid secondary attack damage from 190~240 to 200~240
Reduced Arachnid health from 2,200 to 2,000
Increased Arachnid sprint speed from 3 to 3.2


Changes

Reduced Yoshi Operator's gadget (Scanner) beep sound volume by 50%
Removed DLC button from release popup
Reduced flashiness of "Get a permanent upgrade" on the servers list, and changed its text
Minor script optimization for less RAM usage
Moved the local healthbar further left
All blank icons replaced with a medic icon so that they aren't an eyesore and since the medic icon isn't currently in use and likely will be replaced when a medical operator is added
Changed the direction the matchmaking icon spins


Fixes

Fixed the flesh shell not blocking damage
Fixed glitch where using the vent panels on the left side of the map activated the gas on the right side of the map
Fixed being unable to close the release popup when first launching the game
Fixed glitch where the alien using the flesh shell could cause errors on the hunter's client
Fixed bug where alien's ammo counter would always show as reloading and have 999/999 ammo count


Notes
Crashes are really the most important thing that needs to be addressed, with all the new players in the game it has become obvious that these crashes escaped alpha testing and testers, but that they are very real in the game as it stands. This update helped add a bug fix that should stop crashing altogether, but please let me know if you continue to experience crashes and when they happened, what you were doing, etc.

As a side note, so long as no major problems or glitches arrive I want to aim for releasing the most voted upcoming feature, the Operations game mode. This will take a while since it's an entirely new mode and will likely also require me to redo a bit of the matchmaking and the server's system, but like I said so long as no major bugs or problems arise I should be able to start working toward it.

Should the game have a minimap? It was the most voted feature of the last survey but there are arguments going both ways. Let me know and take a vote:
Minimap Survey

notes.title: Early Access 2.0
notes.content:
Note: If you're still running an older version of the game (see your game version at the top left of the main menu) verify your game files by right-clicking the game, clicking properties > local files > and pressing "Verify integrity of game files". This should force Steam to download the latest updates.

Additions

Game matchmaking
The end round screen now states which team won


Balancing

Reduced Auto Shotgun damage from 70~90 to 65~75


Changes

Servers list is now a separate menu as matchmaking displays first
Corpses of players now stay throughout the match
Reduced face count on almost all in-game models as part of trying to further optimize the game (which resulted in a large download but didn't actually increase the amount of space the game takes up)
Servers that have started now have a lock icon next to them
Locked game modes now have lock symbols
Reduced player flashlight angle from 90 to 70
Rooms are stopped from having the same name and will throw an error if you try
Default room names are now generated with the user's name
Changed the game mode name from "Monster Versus Hunter" to "Alien Versus Hunters"


Fixes

Fixed auto-spawn timer going negative if the leader took a while to load into the game
Fixed the metal shield not being breakable


Bug Reports

The xp bar can go past the bounds


Community

Added an official "Brought to you by Spacefleet!" guide


I would like to note that my guide is written in the format of a propaganda article being sent to Spacefleet ensigns & cadets, and is not an actual guide.

Also, for anyone interested (and who read through all that text) I wanted your opinion on what I should focus on for the next few content updates. So if you have the time, please take this survey!  (Click here to take the survey) 

Thank you all so much for the feedback, it's helping a ton and I'm able to get a lot done because of it!

notes.title: Early Access 1.4
notes.content:
Note: If you're still running an older version of the game verify your game files by right-clicking the game, clicking properties > local files > and pressing "Verify integrity of game files". This should force Steam to download the latest updates.

Additions

Added auto-spawn to spawn screen on the map screen as so far many games have had people leave since the leader wouldn't pick a spawn point
Added escape menu to the in-game map, allowing you to view who is connected and letting you quit the match


Changes

Reduced Auto Shotgun damage from 70~95 to 70~90
Reduced Auto Shotgun range from 5m to 3m
Increased minimum game time required to be rewarded


Fixes

Fixed network buildup error that caused users to crash
Fixed glitch where Vladmir operator would aim too high to hit certain objects while standing still


Bug Reports

Creating a server with the same name as another server (for example two servers with the default name of "New Server") can cause the UI to stop working and would require you to restart your game.
The alien player quickly switching to hunter before the match begins can cause the match to start with no alien player
Auto-Spawn goes negative if the leader takes too long to load into the map
The xp bar can go past the bounds
A hunter player quickly switching to Alien before the match begins can cause the match to start with 2 alien players


In the next content update (Early Access 2) I plan on tackling the glitch where Mission can only activate vents on the right side of the map

In reply to senockson:
Thanks for the great feedback. Vents are meant as alien-only as a way for them to get around the map undetected, although the operator "Mission" can gas these vents to prevent camping and to make them sometimes a more dangerous route. Also if you've clicked on a room and cannot join it please press refresh as the game may have started. And thanks for letting me know about the alien-switching bug, I'll make sure to get on that in the next update!

Sincerely,
Blake Gillman

Fixes

notes.title: Early Access 1.2
notes.content:
A lot of bugs have already been found in the game, and so before too many people are playing I've been working this whole time to fix them. Hope this update helps!

Additions

    Added "Press E to interact" tip to the first-time launch menu
    Added text to the floor in the menu to label interactable menus
    Added red screen overlay when taking damage


Changes

    Changed lobby screen text from "Waiting to spawn" to "Waiting for leader to select one of the spawn circles" to make it more obvious what the leader has to do
    Made health bar stay on screen at all times but go dark when not taking damage


Fixes

    Fixed glitch where pressing E on the online menu a second time would cause multiple menu windows to overlay
    Fixed bug where players who took too long to load into the map would sometimes render the alien as being invisible
    Fixed glitch where the game wouldn't end if the alien left the game


As a side note to some who may feel underwhelmed by the Joshua controller's damage, this is on purpose as he is meant to be a starter operator only and not to be really used past just starting out.
